newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's AIB silent on Riggs bid rumour.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's AIB silent on Riggs bid rumour.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks Plc has refused to comment on speculation that it may be interested in acquiring U.S. banking group, Riggs National Corp.
Weekend Irish newspaper reports said U.S. analysts had suggested Riggs, which is based in Washington D.C., may be a possible target for AIB.
The Irish bank announced last month that its U.S. subsidiary, First Maryland Bancorp. was acquiring Pennsylvania bank Dauphin Deposit Corp for $1.36 billion.
Riggs, which has 57 branches in Washingon and neighbouring Virginia -- where FMB also operates -- has recently separated some of its specialised units into a new division.
